g.text: black: parameter at the fitted thetas; one line per level of a conditioned covariate, other covariates at the pooled centre
this covariate's effect is the SLOPE, a conditioned one's is the GAP between the lines
CONDITIONAL (diamond + coloured line): the source model estimated this effect -- the line is THAT PAPER's own model at its own published values, over the range it enrolled
MARGINAL (round + 10th-90th bar + 2.5th-97.5th whisker): it did not, so admixr2 integrates over the population enrolled
black is the MBMA fit; a coloured line parting from it is a source the meta-analysis disagrees with | grey: extrapolation
